meta.title: Nice to Meet You
meta.description: You scanned our card or met us at an event. Genixo is a software and AI team at Bilkent Cyberpark, Ankara. Here is what we do and how to reach us directly.

hero.title: Nice to meet you.
hero.lead: We're the software department for companies that don't have one, AI included. Here is the short version, and the fastest way to reach us.

items.quote: My team does the same work by hand every day, and mistakes slip through.
items.name: AI process automation
items.text: AI reads, drafts and sorts. Your team approves.

items.quote: Off-the-shelf software doesn't fit us and doesn't talk to our ERP.
items.name: Custom software
items.text: Systems and integrations built around how you work.

items.quote: I have a product idea but no team to build it.
items.name: Product studio
items.text: From idea to a live web or mobile product you own.

items.quote: We need software all the time, but not a whole department.
items.name: NGSD
items.text: An ongoing Genixo team with an assigned project manager.
